title: Cost of estimation for the learned net2: its seven LCFs from net1 or from the truth, on validation
description: Each learned DAgger net2 at its chosen iteration (round 29 on net1 v7, the seven LCFs, iteration 39, seeds 1 to 3; round 27 on net1 v10, 32 LCFs, iteration 59, seeds 1 and 3; model-truth-patch-src) runs twice: as trained (net2-v7-sN, net2-v10-sN), and with expliCCit's seven LCFs taken from the guest's live truth instead of net1 (net2-v7-truth7-sN, net2-v10-truth7-sN; experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py --truth), which also makes the window target the true BDP. Reference lines: the fixed rule at u = 0.25 on net1 v10 (rule-v10) and on net1 v7 (rule-v7), and the same rule on the true LCFs (rule-truth, net1 v7 --oracle; net1 v10's 32 LCFs include some the step does not know). Question, stated before the run: how much do net1's estimation errors cost the learned net2 (arm A1 against A3, without retraining)? A patched policy well above its unpatched self means net1's errors cost that much; level or below means the decision, not the estimates, limits it, or that net2 has adapted to net1's errors. Validation links at campaign seed 21 (the five families) and 2 and 4 copies, as in exp-dagger7-iter-val-279. Nothing is chosen; validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v10" "$IN/t/net1-v10.pt" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v7" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v7o" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25 --oracle; P=(--policy "rule-v10=$OUT/v10/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v7=$OUT/v7/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-truth=$OUT/v7o/rule-u0.25-oracle.onnx"); T7=(queue_delay_mean_ns queue_pkts capacity_bps free_buffer_pkts busy_fraction one_way_delay_ns receive_rate_bps); for r in r29-s1 r29-s2 r29-s3 r27-s1 r27-s3; do case "$r" in r29-*) n=net1-v7.pt; arm=net2-v7;; *) n=net1-v10.pt; arm=net2-v10;; esac; s="${r##*-}"; d="$OUT/runs/$r"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/$n" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/$r.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/$r.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "$arm-$s" "$d" --t 0.5; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "$arm-truth7-$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --truth "${T7[@]}"; P+=(--policy "$arm-$s=$OUT/p/$arm-$s.onnx" --policy "$arm-truth7-$s=$OUT/p/$arm-truth7-$s.onnx"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 26 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-v10
